faqs.q: What are the main changes taking effect May 1, 2026?
faqs.a: The ordinance approved by Arvada City Council makes the following changes: Only real persons with an ownership interest in the property can obtain an STR permit; either an LLC or an individual can own an STR property Stronger enforcement provisions are in place, including mandatory fines in the City's code for operating an STR without a permit or for being in violation of City building code
